header.title: Principal statistics for all companies in the financing (except banking); professional, scientific and technical activities; and administrative and support service activities industries by industry grouping and industry value added
tablenote: Figures in the table may not add up to the total due to rounding.

The financing (except banking) industry excludes investment and holding companies. Within the financing (except banking) industry, industry value added is not compiled for investment and holding companies owing to their special features of business operations.
Figures for 2020 to 2022 include the amount of subsidy related to anti-epidemic measures.
* Figure is not released in order to safeguard confidentiality of information of individual companies or individuals.
header.source: Business Services Statistics Section Census and Statistics Department Tel. : (852) 3903 7268 E-mail : business-services@censtatd.gov.hk
